description: This schema defines the data that is published when a new lead is created.

callback.description: Url to use for sending updates to this lead.

channel.description: The channel that this lead was received.

comments.description: The comments that this lead specified.

consultation_type.description: The consolution types, if any, the lead has selected.

city.description: Name of the city this practice resides

state.description: Name of the state this practice resides

location.description: Location or city of the prospect

provider.description: The provider/doctor for this lead. If no provider was chosen, this will not be present

treatment.description: The treatment the prospect is interested in.

token.description: JWS token for validation and callback.

title: New Lead Webhook
